question: How do I submit a talk proposal?
answer: When the call for proposals is open, use the CFP link on this site. Talks can be in English or Indonesian. First-time speakers are welcome.

question: What kind of talks are you looking for?
answer: Sessions that help developers solve real problems in production: systems architecture, web and mobile engineering, applied AI, reliability, and technical leadership.

question: What talk formats are available?
answer: We run a single track. Formats and durations are listed in the Call for Proposals section when submissions are open.

question: When will the speaker lineup be announced?
answer: We publish the lineup on this site after review. Follow our social channels for announcements.

question: How can I get a ticket?
answer: Use Tickets in the menu or the ticket button at the top of this page. Some rounds, including early bird, are limited and can sell out.

question: Will food and drinks be provided?
answer: Yes, snacks and refreshments are provided throughout both days. If you have dietary requirements, let us know when registering and we will accommodate you.

question: Is there a refund policy?
answer: Tickets are non-refundable once purchased. If your plans change, you can transfer your ticket to a colleague or friend. Email us and we will help transfer the name.

question: Where can I find the latest event updates?
answer: This website is the official source of truth for the event. We also post announcements and schedule updates on our social channels.

question: What should I bring on the day of the event?
answer: Bring your ticket confirmation and a valid ID for check-in. A laptop is optional for note-taking and hallway discussions. If you have questions before the event, email us at idsw@perkodi.org.

question: How do I become a sponsor?
answer: Download the sponsorship proposal from the Sponsors section, or email idsw.sponsor@perkodi.org to reach the partnership desk.
